{"consolidated_memory":"**Plan Drift in infra/terraform/vpc.tf — Two Separate Incidents**

FILE: infra/terraform/vpc.tf (infrastructure/HCL)
PROBLEM: Plan drift in the VPC module
REPRO: Run terraform plan twice with no changes in between
SIGNAL: A diff appears on a resource that nobody edited
COVERING CHECK: terraform plan check in CI

---

**INCIDENT 1: 2026-05-12 — OAuth Provider Sessions**
TRIGGER: Only affected sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
ROOT CAUSE: An error swallowed by a bare except clause
FIX: Narrowed the exception handler to let the failure propagate
- PR #1718 on branch fix/plan-drift-1
RESULT: Flaky test went from 76 failures per 100 runs to zero

**INCIDENT 2: 2026-06-12 — High-Volume Tenant Keys**
TRIGGER: Only affected tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
ROOT CAUSE: A mutable default argument was shared across multiple calls
FIX: Made the default empty and built the required value per call
- PR #6179 on branch fix/plan-drift-2
RESULT: Job execution time improved from 8 hours to 49 minutes"}
